Everything you need to meet someone: ask their name, where they're from, how old they are, whether they work or study. It reuses the verbs you already know (اشتغل، درس، اتكلم، اتعلم) — so here we ask the questions and let those chapters carry the conjugations. Tap any example to reveal its franco and English.

## Two patterns that run through it all

1. **Question words go at the END.** *esmak eh?* is literally "your-name what?", *inta feen?* is "you where?". That's the normal order, not an emphatic one.
2. **There is no "to have".** Egyptian uses **عند (3and)** plus an ending — and the very same word does **age**: *3andak kam sana?* is literally "you have how many years?".

(The بـ on the present-tense verbs below is explained in the *Present Tense* chapter.)

## Question words

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| إيه - eh | what |
| فين - feen | where |
| منين - meneen | from where |
| ليه - leeh | why |
| كام - kam | how much / how many |
| إزاي - ezzay | how |
| مين - meen | who |
| إمتى - emta | when |

## عند — "to have" (and age)

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| عندي - 3andi | I have |
| عندك - 3andak (m.) / 3andek (f.) | you have |
| عنده - 3ando / عندها - 3andaha | he has / she has |
| عندنا - 3andina | we have |

## Where you're from — countries and nationalities

The nationality word doubles as the language name (*3araby* is both "Arab/Arabic").

| Country - franco | Nationality / language - franco |
|---|---|
| مصر - masr | مصري - masri (Egyptian / Arabic) |
| البرازيل - el-Brazil | برازيلي - brazili (Brazilian) |
| البرتغال - el-Borto8al | برتغالي - borto8ali (Portuguese) |
| ألمانيا - Almanya | ألماني - almani (German) |
| أمريكا - Amrika | أمريكاني - amrikani (American) |
| إنجلترا - Engeltera | إنجليزي - ingilizi (English) |

Countries, by the way, are feminine (the *Pronouns* chapter) — *masr 7elwa* "Egypt is beautiful".

## Work or study

These all reuse verbs from the *Work* and *Studying and Learning* chapters — here just as questions.

<details class="frase">
<summary>بتشتغل ولا بتدرس؟</summary>
<span class="fr">bitishta8al walla bitidris?</span>
<span class="en">do you work or study?</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>بتشتغل إيه؟</summary>
<span class="fr">bitishta8al eh?</span>
<span class="en">what do you do? (what's your job?)</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>بتتكلم لغات إيه؟</summary>
<span class="fr">bititkallim lo8at eh?</span>
<span class="en">what languages do you speak?</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>بتتعلم عربي ليه؟</summary>
<span class="fr">bitit3allim 3araby leeh?</span>
<span class="en">why are you learning Arabic?</span>
</details>

## What's this called? Whose is it? How much?

<details class="frase">
<summary>ده اسمه إيه؟</summary>
<span class="fr">da esmo eh?</span>
<span class="en">what's this called? (m.)</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>دي اسمها إيه؟</summary>
<span class="fr">di esmaha eh?</span>
<span class="en">what's this called? (f.)</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>ده بتاع مين؟</summary>
<span class="fr">da bita3 meen?</span>
<span class="en">whose is this? (بتاع from This and That)</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>ده بكام؟</summary>
<span class="fr">da bekam?</span>
<span class="en">how much is this? (price)</span>
</details>

## A few expressions to keep things going

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| إيه الجديد؟ - eih el-gdid? | what's new? |
| مفيش جديد - mafiish gdid | nothing new |
| بجد؟ - bigadd? | really? |
| بس / لكن - bas / lakin | but |
| عشان - 3ashan | because / so that |
| عندي فضول - 3andi fodool | I'm curious |

## Dialogue: meeting someone

Hany meets a newcomer at a language meetup.

<span class="rotulo">هاني — Hany</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>أهلاً! إنت منين؟</summary>
<span class="fr">ahlan! inta meneen?</span>
<span class="en">Hi! Where are you from?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">Guest</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>أنا من البرازيل</summary>
<span class="fr">ana men el-Brazil</span>
<span class="en">I'm from Brazil</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">هاني — Hany</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>وعايش فين دلوقتي؟</summary>
<span class="fr">we 3aysh feen delwa2ti?</span>
<span class="en">And where do you live now?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">Guest</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>عايش في ريو</summary>
<span class="fr">3aysh fi Rio</span>
<span class="en">I live in Rio</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">هاني — Hany</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بتشتغل ولا بتدرس؟</summary>
<span class="fr">bitishta8al walla bitidris?</span>
<span class="en">Do you work or study?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">Guest</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بشتغل، وبتعلم عربي</summary>
<span class="fr">bashta8al, we bat3allim 3araby</span>
<span class="en">I work, and I'm learning Arabic</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">هاني — Hany</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بجد؟ بتتعلم عربي ليه؟</summary>
<span class="fr">bigadd? bitit3allim 3araby leeh?</span>
<span class="en">Really? Why are you learning Arabic?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">Guest</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>عشان عندي فضول</summary>
<span class="fr">3ashan 3andi fodool</span>

</details>
